slow-cooker.name: Crock-Pot 7-Quart Oval Manual Slow Cooker
slow-cooker.description: Spacious 7-quart capacity with high, low, and warm settings. Engineered for reliable low-and-slow cooking, tender braises, and long-simmered comfort meals.
features: 7-Quart capacity (serves 8+ people)
High, Low, and Warm manual temperature controls
Removable oval stoneware & dishwasher-safe glass lid

mandoline-slicer.name: Bron Coucke Stainless Steel Classic Mandoline
mandoline-slicer.description: Professional all-stainless French mandoline. Delivers wafer-thin cabbage cuts, julienne ribbons, and uniform vegetable slices with mathematical consistency.
features: Heavy-duty 18/10 stainless steel construction
Built-in reversible flat and crinkle/waffle blades
Adjustable lever for precise slice thickness control

sheet-pan.name: Stainless Steel Baking Sheet with Wire Rack Set
sheet-pan.description: Heavy-duty pure stainless steel rimmed baking sheet with fitted elevated cooling/roasting rack. Maximizes hot air circulation for crisp roasting without soggy undersides.
features: Pure food-grade stainless steel (zero toxic chemical coatings)
Elevated wire grid rack for 360-degree convective heat flow
Warp-resistant rimmed edges, oven & dishwasher safe

power-blender.name: Ninja Detect Duo Power Blender Pro
power-blender.description: Professional 1800-peak-watt motor base with BlendSense technology that automatically adjusts speed and time based on fresh or frozen ingredients. Perfect for velvety pestos, silky soups, and smooth purees.
features: 1800 Peak Watts high-torque motor base
BlendSense automated technology detects ingredients & portion sizes
Includes 72 oz. full-size pitcher and single-serve travel cups

microplane-zester.name: Microplane Premium Classic Series Zester Grater
microplane-zester.description: The gold-standard culinary zester made with surgical-grade stainless steel. Transforms hard cheeses like parmesan into fluffy clouds and zests citrus oils effortlessly without bitter pith.
features: Surgical-grade stainless steel photo-etched blades
Soft-touch ergonomic handle with non-scratch rubber end feet
Dishwasher safe and includes reusable protective blade cover

instant-read-thermometer.name: Alpha Grillers Instant Read Digital Meat Thermometer
instant-read-thermometer.tagline: Sub-Second Thermal Precision & Core Target Analysis
instant-read-thermometer.description: Ultra-fast digital food probe delivering accurate core temperature readings in 2-3 seconds. Waterproof, backlit, and factory pre-calibrated to eliminate guesswork on roasts, poultry, and pan-seared fish.
features: 2-3 Second ultra-fast thermal response time
IP66 Waterproof body with bright LED backlit screen
Pre-calibrated accuracy with internal auto on/off probe switch

air-fryer.name: Ninja Pro 4-in-1 Air Fryer with Air Crisp Technology
air-fryer.tagline: Rapid Convective Airflow & Low-Oil Texture Optimization
air-fryer.description: Engineered for 400°F rapid convective air circulation to achieve mathematical crispiness using up to 75% less fat. Includes air fry, roast, reheat, and dehydrate modes in an easy-to-clean ceramic coated basket.
features: Air Crisp Technology delivers up to 400°F convective heat flow
4-in-1 Versatility: Air Fry, Roast, Reheat, and Dehydrate
Non-stick ceramic-coated basket and crisper plate, dishwasher safe
